facts.fact: Minister of Labour and Home Affairs Pius Mokgware handed citizenship documents to 64 refugees at the World Refugee Day commemoration at Dukwi, reported by BOPA.

systems.owner: Ministry of Justice and Correctional Services

note: States the Refugees Act commenced and funds a Dukwi records system, but gives no registration, documents or digital access for refugees.
Mentions the Refugees Act passing only; no registration, documents or digital access for displaced people.

facts.fact: The Patriot reports that BOCRA's compulsory SIM registration in 2024 led to deregistration of SIM cards of refugees and migrants without ID, leaving them cut off from mobile networks.

The Patriot reports Parliament passed the Refugees (Recognition and Management) Bill 23 of 2024, which provides for issuing identity cards (Omang) to every person granted refugee status, so they can register SIM cards and meet KYC.

Botswana's Justice Minister says Clause 25 of Bill No. 23 of 2024, then before Parliament, would have every recognised refugee and their family members issued an ID by the minister responsible for civil and national registration.
